messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick heads-up — CloudMarketCo just asked for a GA readiness checklist for their marketplace listing. I drafted one and added a small Terraform compatibility matrix. Link: https://internal.redwood/partners/cloudmarketco/ga-checklist :eyes:
chris (eng): Nice — can you paste the matrix? need to know which OS/cloud & hw combos we must validate. Also: are we giving them modules or pointing to upstream registry?
anna (solutions): We should provide a partner-specific module bundle (tar + registry modules). Legal wants semver tags and a CHANGELOG.md.
jordan (eng-platform): Matrix from maria earlier shows targets: x86 (g4dn), arm64 Graviton (a1/ampere), and baremetal reference. I'll wire up CI jobs for each. Quick test command I'll use: `make integra-test PARTNER=cloudmarketco TARGET=$TARGET`
sarah (sre): For baremetal tests we need a small smoke harness to validate GPU drivers and nvlink. Let's not run full perf tests during partner QA window.
maria (partnerships): Here's the small matrix snippet I added to the checklist: `x86:g4dn, linux, tf-module v1.2.0; arm64:ampere, linux, tf-module v1.2.0-amp; baremetal:equnix, ubuntu20.04, tf-module v1.2.0-bare` — values are provisional.
chris (eng): For tf modules, can we add a provider override so partners can point to our local registry? e.g.:
```hcl
module "redwood_inference" {
  source = "registry.redwood.com/partners/cloudmarketco/redwood_inference"
  region = var.region
}
```
That will make acceptance tests predictable.
anna (solutions): I'll prepare a short README with example outputs and a troubleshooting section for common provider auth issues.
maria (partnerships): TL;DR action items: 1) chris/jordan — add provider override and CI jobs (owner: jordan) 2) anna — README + changelog (owner: anna) 3) sarah — provide baremetal smoke harness and test checklist (owner: sarah) 4) maria — finalize checklist and coordinate partner comms. Target: GA-readiness review on Mon (2167950000) :white_check_mark:
jordan (eng-platform): I'll create a GH PR to add three CI workflows and wire them to the partner branch. PR will include a small `matrix.json` and a `test/acceptance.sh` that toggles target.
deploy-bot: New file added to partners repo: /docs/cloudmarketco/ga-checklist.md (uploaded by maria)
maria (partnerships): Thanks everyone — posting this here so cross-functional folks can jump in. If anyone needs me to split tasks into the partner JIRA, ping me and I'll create tickets. :rocket:
